answer: Full analysis complete; all six artifacts written to the workspace root and verified against the submission contract. Final network: 47 directed edges, off-diagonal density 7.83% (within the required 5–40% band, verified in-code before writing), no NaN/Inf, float64, zero diagonal, signs in {−1,0,+1} exactly aligned with the nonzero topology. Hub genes (out-degree ranking with |strength| tie-break): gene 16 (out-degree 8) and gene 19 (out-degree 7), with 18 (6), 14 (5), 0 (4) next. 29 positive / 18 negative edges; max in-degree 6 (gene 18), mean degree 1.88. Methods: (A) transient-only linear ODE (elastic net, per-gene R² reported; mean 0.821, median 0.919) with lambda-path × bootstrap stability selection and a 2σ noise floor from the replicate structure (σ=0.046); (B) perturbation driver-response analysis with inferred node-level clamps (KO→0, OE→~10, module-repetition exclusions), co-intervention-weighted median response ratios, sign-consistency confidence (mean 0.808 over 218 multi-intervention pairs), coverage discounting, and a noise floor. Combination: evidence gate (kinetically stable freq≥0.7 OR causally supported: ≥2 obs with conf≥0.6 and effect>2σ, or a single observation from a ≤3-clamp condition with effect>6σ) plus artifact guards (sources need kinetic range or clamp evidence — this eliminated a gene-20 artifact regulating 22 targets; near-constant targets 1/20 need strong support), 50/50 score ranking, single global threshold scanned for the density target. Key methodological findings along the way (documented in method_comparison.json): (1) the wild-type transient is highly collinear so transient-only L1 selection is partly arbitrary and misses causally-verified edges; (2) interventions are multi-gene clamps and responses are nonlinear in the overexpression direction, so the balance-equation regression (tried and REJECTED) overfits; (3) spike columns of clamped drivers make single-condition balance attribution unidentifiable — hence the gate design. Limitations: gene 19's hub rank rests partly on single-condition evidence from condition 11 (co-clamped with 16/18); A-vs-B sign agreement on doubly-signed kept edges is low (0.27, n=11) reflecting direct-vs-transitive semantics; intervention targets are inferred, not documented; response nonlinearity means steady-state evidence is ancestry, not strictly direct edges.
